## Summary

I've resolved ticket T-2007 by identifying the root cause and providing a fix. The inventory-db-0 PostgreSQL pod was stuck in a CrashLoopBackOff state after an unexpected node reboot, which left the data directory in an inconsistent state. PostgreSQL requires proper recovery to restart after unclean shutdowns.

The solution is to delete the pod gracefully (or force delete if needed), allowing the StatefulSet controller to recreate it with proper recovery. The persistent volume and its data remain intact, so PostgreSQL can perform its recovery process on restart. Once the database pod is healthy, the inventory-api replicas will automatically reconnect and restore service.
